Lemma
[chart velocity bounded by the conserved speed]

↗ lem:dc-ch3-4-2-speedchart

1. ch3:4.2For every $p$ there are a constant $c>0$ and a neighborhood $V$ of $\varphi _p(p)$ such that, whenever a curve $\gamma $ reads into $V$ at $t$ with coordinate velocity $\xi =(\varphi _p\circ \gamma )'(t)$, one has $\| \xi \| ^2\le c\, \langle \gamma '(t),\gamma '(t)\rangle _g$. Along a geodesic the right-hand side is constant, so this bounds the chart velocity uniformly along the geodesic by its initial speed.
Proof

\sketch

The uniform coordinate-norm bound $\| \xi \| ^2\le c\, \langle \xi ,\xi \rangle _{p,y}$ (positive-definiteness of the Gram form, spread over a neighborhood of $\varphi _p(p)$ by the tube lemma) combined with the fixed-chart speed reading section 3.

□
